summary: Thingsboard is an open-source platform designed for Internet of Things workloads. It provides tools for device management, data collection, processing, and visual representation of connected hardware metrics. It is distributed under the Apache-2.0 licence.
goodFor: It suits developers and organisations building self-hosted IoT monitoring pipelines that require structured telemetry ingestion and dashboarding.
watchOut: The enterprise stack is built with Java and containerised orchestration tools, which implies a significant operational baseline and memory footprint compared to lighter single-binary alternatives.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy this via Docker or Kubernetes with persistent volumes for data storage and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination for device endpoints.
